subject: Pen Test: access window & remediation tracking
messages:
From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@nmap-security.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test kickoff & scope confirmation (Acme)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for choosing NMap Security for the Acme Corp engagement. Attached is the SOW and proposed test window. Quick summary of ask so we can kick off next week: 

- Confirm test scope: external internet-facing SaaS endpoints, auth flows, file upload processing, and API rate-limit bypass attempts.
- Confirm target IPs/hostnames and any explicit exclusions.
- Provide time window for authenticated and unauthenticated testing (we recommend a 4-hour authenticated window and a 2-hour unauthenticated window).
- We need a point of contact and temporary test accounts (privilege-limited) + allowlist IPs for our scanner.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-02-17 09:00 PT (90-minute call) and testing to begin after the call on a rolling basis.

Attachments: PenTest_SOW_v1.pdf (scope, timeline, deliverables)

If you want to restrict scope we can adjust — call out anything you want excluded.

Regards,
Jordan Reed
Principal Consultant, NMap Security
jordan.reed@nmap-security.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

--
NMap Security | http://nmap-security.example.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@nmap-security.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pen test kickoff & scope confirmation (Acme)

Jordan — thanks for the SOW and clear plan. A few clarifications from our side (Acme has asked us to be explicit):

1) Scope change: please exclude internal-only admin network (10.10.0.0/16) and the legacy on-prem environment — we only want exposure testing against the public SaaS tenant and its APIs. Acme wants to avoid load testing on their job queue ingestion endpoint between 20:00-06:00 PT.

2) Access: we will provide three temporary test accounts (auth roles: read-only, support-rep, api-client) and a short-lived API key for the auth flow tests. Dev — can you provision the accounts and a jumpbox allowlist for Jordan's IPs?

3) Timing: Tue 2026-02-17 09:00 PT works for the kickoff call. Please send calendar invite.

4) Deliverable expectations: Acme expects an interim findings summary within 48 hours of testing completing and the full report + remediation guidance within 10 business days.

CC'ing Alex to confirm SLA alignment and Marissa for account coordination.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Thanks Vivek — we can do the exclusions you listed. A few notes and requests before the kickoff: 

- Please provide the three temporary accounts with credentials by Mon 2026-02-16 18:00 PT. Mark them with "pen-test" in the username so the team can distinguish.
- We will perform authenticated checks using a short-lived API key; please create an API key with scope limited to read and test endpoints.
- IP allowlist: our scanner will originate from 54.213.22.101 and 34.216.88.77 (both N. California). Please open outbound only for those during the test windows.
- I created a shared folder with minimal access instructions: https://redwood-drive.internal/shared/pen-test-8342 (contains access_instructions.txt).

Jordan

Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 07:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Pen-test remediation owners & quick playbook

Vivek — internal follow-up after the kickoff call (notes below). I included Mina for incident response sign-off and Marissa for account coordination.

Summary of findings (interim, immediately actionable items to assign):
- HIGH: Unauthenticated file upload content-type bypass on /api/v1/uploads -> Owner: Mina Haddad -> ETA for mitigation patch: 2026-02-19 EOD.
- MEDIUM: Missing rate-limit on public-facing search API -> Owner: Dev Patel -> ETA: 2026-02-20.
- LOW: Insecure cookie flags on the legacy auth redirect (excluded from test) -> Owner: Alex Martinez -> ETA: 2026-02-24.

Action items:
- Mina: implement content-type validation middleware and deploy to staging by 02/19.
- Dev: add a throttling layer in front of search API and add metrics alerts.
- Alex: schedule a redirect auth review with the infra team and document the legacy behavior.
- Marissa: notify Acme that we have owners+ETAs and confirm acceptance of those dates.

Attachments: none (all notes in thread).

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Pen test: interim report delivered & remediation verification schedule

Team — scan completed earlier today. Attached is the interim findings summary with reproduction steps for the three confirmed issues. High-level timeline: 

- Interim findings (attached) delivered: 2026-02-18 (attached: interim_findings_summary.pdf).
- Full technical report and remediation guidance: expected by 2026-02-27.
- Remediation verification (rescan): tentatively scheduled for 2026-03-02; please confirm expected fix dates so we can slot the rescan.

Key asks for Redwood/Acme:
- Confirm that the owners/ETAs listed in Dev's internal note (see thread) are final. If any ETA moves, please update Jordan and Sarah.
- Provide access to the staging environment URL for verification (not production).

Sarah — looping you from Acme so you have the interim doc; let me know if you want us to redact any customer identifiers before the full report.

Regards,
Jordan Reed
Principal Consultant, NMap Security

Attachments: interim_findings_summary.pdf (contains repro steps, PoCs, and screenshots)
